blurb: Finds battles, sieges and breakthroughs that turned on an edge (a tactic, a technology, a piece of science, a supply line) and writes them in StoryMaker with every fact sourced.
_whyNoRecordsShape: Its rows (the campaign fact ledger: strength, supply, ground held) live inside StoryMaker projects and the story folder's plan.json, which have their own stores (history/domains/pivotal-history/voice.md §8). The author's decisions (which pilot, the opening rule) are open loops, not records.
_whyTools: The author, 2026-10-20: he drives the whole pipeline from this assistant, from a new story to its podcast and video. 2026-10-21, he asked it to upload the approved videos to YouTube: AI Web actions (proposeActions) go through AI Web's own gate, a card per step or the author's per-site Always allow, and a job can never call them. Script Creator voices the episodes, AI Slides holds each video's storyboard and the Video Recorder makes and exports it, so all three are granted whole: each step leaves something he can open and change. Publishing is not granted: audiocast.publishEpisode, unpublishEpisode, channel (it can make a feed public) and artwork reach him as an assistant.proposeAction card, and his click on it runs the verb (Phase JM). hub.deploy puts the series site live (2026-10-21): its kind is external, so each call waits for his approval and a job can never make it. Stages run as jobs the assistant starts itself (assistant.startJob with a brief; mChatAI+ docs/ASSISTANT_JOBS_PLAN.md §7); a job can never publish, propose or start a job.
_whyFreeTools: The History Writer's split (design D6): scouting and reading dossiers are free, writing into StoryMaker is premium. The scout report goes to AI Write, so aiwrite.* stays free, as it is for history-writer. Jobs are on every plan, since a scout runs as one; a job keeps its assistant's grants, so on the free plan it can do only free things.
_whyWorkdirLinks: ./history carries the engine (PLAYBOOK, voice, tools) and this domain (history/domains/pivotal-history/). The campaign bible is applied by id through storymaker.applyBiblePack, so story/ needs no link.
_whyBudget: A ceiling against a runaway, not a price: on a subscription these are the dollars the API would have charged. Sized to measured runs: the second telling of Alesia cost $58.79 over its three stage jobs (plan $2.61, chapters $46.28, finish $9.90, 2026-10-19) and this assistant's own thread a few dollars a day. Room for one story and its publishing in a day. It was $5.00 while only a driver outside the app started stages; started from here, that would refuse the first one.
